  • Which Currency Only Accept?

AUD = Australian Dollar.



  • How To Create An Account ?

Click The 【REGISTER】 Button On The Homepage To Register. After Successful Registration. Click The 【DEPOSIT】Button To Top Up And WIN.



  • Can I Register Multiple Accounts?

Member Cannot Register Multiple Account. Once The Rules Are Violated, Account Will Be Restricted And Members Benefit Will Disqualified.



  • What Are The Deposit And Withdrawal Limits?

Minimum Deposit AUD 10.

Minimum Withdrawal AUD 20. ( WITHOUT BONUS )

#Deposit Of Any Amount ""Requires Rollover X1"" ( Total Bet )



  • Can I Top Up If I Still Have Balance?

In Order To Avoid Confusion In The Bonus Rules. You Must Play And Bet Your Points After Each Deposit. Once The Points Are Lower Than AUD 0.1 or After Withdrawal, You Be Able To Summit Deposit Again.



  • What is Our ROLLOVER And WINOVER/TURNOVER?

Our Company There Are Only With Rollover And Winover/Turnover, All According To The Following Instruction.

ROLLOVER : Total Bet In Game.

WINOVER/TURNOVER : Minimum Withdraw / Final Remain Credit.



  • Can I Claim Different Bonus At The Same Time?

Cannot Apply At The Same Time For Any Bonus, Promotion, Rebate, Commission & Voucher. Although Sometimes You Can Click Multiple Different Bonuses. But It Will Superimpose Different Withdrawal Rules Onto The Same Bonus. Once The Rules Are Violated Will Forfeit The Bonus.



  • Why Games Platforms Sometimes Disappear?

For A Better Game Environment And Effect Sometimes Some Game Platforms Will Be Maintenance.

During The Maintenance Period, The Game Platform Will Be Temporarily Removed From Website, Once Done Recovery Website Will Appear Again.



  • Is Every Game Playable?

In The Absence Of Claim Bonus, Every Game Can Be Played. In The Case Of Claim Bonus, Only The Corresponding Games Are Allowed To Be Played. Arcade, Table, Poker, Bingo & Fish Require A Minimum Deposit Of AUD300. All Credit Will Be Forfeited Subject To Any Violation Of Rules.



  • I Have Met The Rollover Requirement, Why Can't Withdraw Money?

Deposit And Applying For Bonus Will Have Rollover Requirements. Once You Complete The Rollover Requirements, Please Exit The Game Completely And Give The System Some Time To Update The Rollover Progress Bar.

Once The Rollover Progress Bar Is Full Withdrawals Can Be Made.

In Order To Protect Bank Account Of Both Sides, We Are Strict Customers To Change Bank Account, Unless Your Registered Account Is Frozen/Blocked. We Will Verify The Authenticity And Ask For Some Supporting Documents.
